dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #Huh? Is that... {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight!? Yippee, it's you!

choices.text: Hey, it's Klee!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Haha, Aunty Eula told Klee that Miss Hertha had found someone amazing to help out...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Seeing you here, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight, Klee knows this must be the best drinks stand in all of Teyvat!

choices.text: So kind of you to say, Klee. That's the ultimate goal!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Y—You mean this stand ISN'T already the best?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Well... out of all the drinks stands Klee's ever visited, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight's is easily the best!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Aaand... no matter what drinks {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight makes, Klee will definitely think they're yummy!

choices.text: This time, Klee, I need you to be a little tougher on me!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh! Y—You want me to be mean? But... Klee could never be mean to you...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Hmm, let me think... I know! I'll pretend to be Albedo!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Whenever Albedo reviews Timaeus's work, his face goes super serious, and Klee can hear every word he says!

choices.text: Brilliant, then you can be my teacher!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Heehee... Get ready for Klee's super amazing order!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I'm going fish-blasting with Mom soon... Don't tell Master Jean, though!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Me and Mom blasted sooo many fish today... Don't tell Master Jean, though!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: These past few days, I've been having such a blast with Mom all day long! It's been so much fun! Even being sent to solitary confinement couldn't wipe the smile off my face!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: So, Klee wants to order a Fairweather Frolic. Anything like a bright, sunny day will definitely put Klee in a super-duper mood!

choices.text: Got it, Miss Klee, I'll get right on it!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Heehee... I wonder what it'll taste like...

choices.text: Understood, Master Alchemist Klee, I'll get right on it!
Brilliant, then you can be Master Alchemist Klee!
This time, you can criticize me all you like!
So kind of you to say, Klee. I'm working hard to become the best!
Hey, Customer Klee!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tada! It's done — I just know you're going to love this new creation!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Wow! There's Dodoco Candy on top!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: There's so much orange in this cup, and Dodoco looks like he's lying on top of white, fluffy clouds... and the weather inside looks much better, too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to taste it?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Klee has to drink slowly... I can't just gulp it down, or I'll miss all the yummy flavor!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #{M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight, this is amazing... It's like you mixed sunshine with juice!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Klee was so tired from playing, but now I feel refreshed... and warm... and peaceful...?

choices.text: How about you choose a name for this drink, Klee?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Really? Let me think...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Hmm... When the weather's nice, and Dodoco's happy, Dodoco will want to sing, right?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: And when Dodoco sings, Klee wants to sing, too... So, let's call it... Dodoco's Duet!

choices.text: What a wonderful name!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Heehee, thank you — and thanks for making such a yummy drink for Klee!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Klee's gonna go tell Mom that the best drink in Mondstadt right now is Dodoco's Duet!

choices.text: I'm glad you like it!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Heehee! Klee's gonna write down Mom's incantation and give you a copy, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Then you should learn magic too, so you can make all the candies you want!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: See you next time!

choices.text: I passed your test, Miss Klee!
Your names are the best!
I'm sure you'll come up with something amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your Fairweather Frolic is here. Go on, give it a try!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Wow, so a Fairweather Frolic is this color? Purple sky... Is it supposed to be a bright, shiny night?

choices.text: Maybe it's supposed to be a cloudless sky at dusk?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Klee will take a sip first... Then you can think about it more carefully.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Ahhh, finished...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yummy! Both sweet AND sour!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: If Klee drank this while eating Grilled Fish, I could definitely gobble down two, or three, or four, or even... five!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: But one drink isn't enough. Klee wants to try... a drink that tastes like cake!

choices.text: Roger that. How about a "Cake in a Cup"?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Hmm... Klee doesn't know what drink to choose. Why don't we decide together, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That candy you've brought with you looks very special!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: This stuff? Heehee... Mom taught me how to make it using the alchemy bench!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: A dash of sugar... then a lot more sugar, then some flowers from Mom's friend in Fontaine, star honey from Aunty Barbie, and finally some magical jam from Aunty Tavia...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Put everything together on the alchemy table, wish for the shape you want, then recite Mom's incantation, and... poof! Dodoco-shaped candy!

choices.text: That's quite the process...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Klee can give you some Dodoco Candy, too, if you want! And if you really like them, I could even teach you my mom's incantation!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: That way, you could make your own candy whenever you want!

choices.text: Thanks for sharing your amazing recipe, Klee!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Heehee, if you get stuck, remember to come ask Klee! When it comes to magical candy, I'm an expert!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you have any other plans for today?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah! Mom gave me an amazing book recently. She said I have to read one chapter every night, learn something useful, and then go to bed early!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: That book taught Klee how to make something called "propellant." Now Jumpy Dumpty can go "Phwooar!" and bounce even higher!

choices.text: I—Is that really something you should be learning?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: It's not hard at all... In fact, it's a lot like making bombs. You just have to be careful when trimming it down — it's like sharpening a pencil that could suddenly go BOOM!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Bedtime's an important part of Klee's schedule too! Mom sits by my side and tells me all kinds of wonderful stories.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: She has a lamp made of gemstones, and when she turns it on, it goes "ka-bling" and lights up the ceiling.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Does the ceiling show scenes from the stories?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah! When something happens in the story, the lights on the ceiling make pretty pictures...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Sometimes, Mom falls asleep before the story ends, so Klee has to tuck her in instead...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #As soon as Klee learns how to use the lamp, I can come tell you stories, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight!

choices.text: That sounds great!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Heehee, Klee has memorized so many wonderful stories — enough to make everyone happy every day!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you plan to eat anything else today?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah! When Klee gets back home, I'm gonna eat some salted nuts while reading my book!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Klee used to eat cake after dinner, but Master Jean said it's too sugary, and it's not good to eat sugary things before bed! Apparently, it makes you chubby and gives you toothaches!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: So Mom got some advice from Aunty Barbie, and now she gives me nuts instead. She says they help my brain remember things better!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Nuts don't have much flavor — it's like chewing on grass — but they're okay if you add a little salt!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That sounds like a great solution — nutritious and healthy!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There must be some ingredients that are both healthy and sweet...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh yeah... Klee still wants to eat sweet things — like cake, for example! Maybe we could just go easy on the cream... or add more fruit?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh, right! That friend of Mom's who's always wearing glasses gave her a big bag of Fontainian Bulle Fruit. They're so round and rolly!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Klee ate a whole bunch of those, and they were super sweet... but Master Jean said it was okay, because "sweet fruit isn't the same as sweet sugar!"

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: So if Klee really has to eat nuts, maybe I can just soak them in some fruit juice first?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Speaking of food, I hope you're getting your three square meals a day?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Three square meals? Heehee, Klee often eats five meals a day — sometimes even seven!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Seriously!?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Adventuring takes a lot of energy, and if I eat too much at once, I can't run so well... So it's better to eat lots of smaller meals!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Albedo used to prepare all Klee's meals, and my lunchbox was always arranged so neatly, just like a pretty painting!

choices.text: That sounds like Albedo, alright...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: When Albedo's busy at Dragonspine, Klee goes to eat with the other Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Kaeya's camp is usually the neatest, while Amber sometimes camps in the trees — it's so much fun! Oh, and Aunty Hertha makes the best food!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: When my mom comes back, there'll be even more yummy food to eat. There's this one dish where she takes loads of different fish and makes them into little pudding cubes — it's called Rainbow Fish Jelly!

choices.text: You're making me hungry...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Her Chococo Crunchy Slices are fantastic too! It's her newest creation, made with chocolate and cookies! They're a little bitter, but they're crunchy, they smell scrumptious, and they have a really sweet aftertaste!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Whenever I eat them, I feel sooo full of energy... Next time, Klee will have to bring some for you to try!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, I think I know how to improve that drink!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let me mix another one for you!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah! That was quick!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Klee's looking forward to finding out how tasty your next concoction is!

choices.text: Great food from a great adventurer...
I'd like to try Albedo's cooking sometime...
I'll be waiting!
I—Is that easy to do?
I'll work really hard to learn how to do it!
What an amazing treat...
Alright, get ready for another super yummy drink!
Any flavor Klee wants, she can have!
It's not the most fitting color... How about I make a few changes?
